user.title: Connect GitHub Copilot
user.description: Create a fine-grained personal access token at https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new with the **Copilot Requests** account permission (read-only), then paste it below. Requests are billed to your Copilot plan. The first setup downloads the Copilot runtime (~120 MB), which can take a minute.

data_description.access_token: Fine-grained personal access token with the Copilot Requests permission.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate GitHub Copilot
reauth_confirm.description: The stored token no longer works. Paste a new fine-grained personal access token with the **Copilot Requests** permission.

progress.validate: Checking the token and starting the GitHub Copilot runtime. The first run downloads the runtime and can take a minute or two.

error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected, or it has no access to GitHub Copilot.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach GitHub or start the Copilot runtime. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This GitHub account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The new token belongs to a different GitHub account.

data_description.chat_model: Copilot model to use. Premium models consume premium requests from your plan.
data_description.reasoning_effort: Higher effort can improve quality but is slower. Ignored by models without reasoning support.
data_description.prompt: Instruct how the assistant should respond. This can be a template.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Let Copilot control and query entities exposed to Assist.
